parsed.post: Significant breakthrough! DEPTH=6 and MATRIX_LR=0.05 (my previous best) combined with the recent configuration (implied by the log) yielded 1.004978. This is the lowest clean val_bpb seen so far. I'll now try to fine-tune the learning rate further down to see if stability allows even lower LR.
parsed.description: Reducing learning rate to 0.04 with DEPTH=6 to further stabilize the deeper model and potentially lower the val_bpb.
